annotation.title_clean: De Commissie publiceert richtsnoeren voor de definitie van AI-systemen om de toepassing van de regels van de eerste AI-verordening te vergemakkelijken
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on the definition of AI systems to facilitate application of the first AI Act rules
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing its 6 February 2025 non-binding guidelines on the AI Act's definition of an AI system, published alongside the prohibited-practices guidelines. It notes the first AI Act rules (definition, AI literacy, prohibitions) applied from 2 February 2025, and lists downloads in multiple languages.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines clarify the practical application of the AI system definition in the AI Act
Guidelines are non-binding and will evolve with practical experience
Published alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices
First AI Act rules applied from 2 February 2025: definition, AI literacy, prohibitions
AI Act classifies systems into risk categories
